findings: The SDK honored remove_io_quantization and produced a distinct serialized model.
The frozen simulator predictions were byte-identical to the baseline, so accuracy and parity did not improve.

config.goal: Reduce Axelera raw-output YOLO26n INT8 confidence error by removing graph-boundary I/O quantization.
config.scope: One-variable SDK 1.7.0 host quantization experiment; frozen ten-image COCO screen; no AIPU execution.
config.verify: Reviewed eval_quantized_raw.py screen at threshold 0.25 plus effective compile-config, artifact-SHA, and prediction-byte comparisons against raw-output-minmax.

interpretation: The SDK honored remove_io_quantization and produced a different serialized quantized model, but the frozen simulator emitted byte-identical candidate predictions and identical quality/parity metrics. The setting changes graph serialization without improving this inference path.
non_claim: This phase contains no Metis AIPU compile, execution, quality, latency, or deployment result.
